name: @nuri/spec
description: Nuri spec · authored data plus one dependency-free executable composition contract. NO-DEPS / NO-SCRIPTS / NO generated artifacts. Tree: tokens/ (dimension·colour·typography SoTs) · axes/ (definition tables) · components/ (descriptors + schema) · composition/ (engine-agnostic classifier) · icons/ (SVG SoT). Every consumer projection owns its generated output: @nuri/rn (the RN contract) + @nuri/prototype (web CSS + twins). The codegen lives in root scripts/.

The generated subpaths ./tokens ./token-paths ./token-vars ./interaction ./icons ./palette were DROPPED: the resolved RN contract now lives in @nuri/rn/generated/ (contract.ts imports it locally) + the web token-vars in @nuri/prototype/generated/. The axis/SoT subpaths map to axes/ + tokens/ and remain PURE DATA. @nuri/rn reads the authored classifier directly; @nuri/prototype reads its generated verbatim browser twin. The build/ + pipeline/ + lib/ + styles/ dirs are GONE; @nuri/spec is data + this one executable composition contract.
